fusions.name: Gleaned Nibbles
fusions.desc: Looses 5 biting motes at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. 15% of the damage it deals comes back as healing over the following 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Cloud Burst
fusions.desc: Hurls a seething cloud that deals 28 nature damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Swarm Bait
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A swarm fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1 second.

fusions.name: Gleaning Hopper
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded swarm familiar that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
